title: Business Central Queries: Simplifying Complex Data
summary: Business Central Query objects allow developers to combine data from multiple tables using joins and filters, similar to SQL queries. Queries simplify complex data retrieval by defining linked data items with columns and join types, and can be exposed in Business Central for analysis and reporting.
key_points: Query objects link multiple tables together with join conditions, replacing the need for direct SQL access
Four SQL join types control how data combines: Inner, Left Outer, Right Outer, and Full Outer joins
Queries are declared with a source table, dependent data items with DataItemLink definitions, and filtered columns
Queries can be exposed in Business Central UI for searching and analyzing, then exported to Excel or pivot table analysis

quotes.text: Queries are a nested set of linked and filtered data items.
quotes.why_it_matters: This defines the core concept of how queries work as the fundamental unit for multi-table data retrieval

quotes.text: Left is the parent Data Item and Right is the dependent Data Item.
quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding the directional concept of joins in Business Central is critical for developers to write correct query syntax
